Importing ER triage concept: priority rendering for active chat & settings, backgrounding passive telemetry metrics.
Challenge: Lazy loading must not flicker or drop user inputs when toggling between settings sub-pages.
Scoring: Triage rendering + instant state update passes with 9.5/10 score. Proceed with implementation target.
Thesis Round 1: Adopt instant optimistic state updates with background verification hooks.
